Regression fixture: credit_capacity_feasible.npz

Derived from runs/context-audit-v1 frozen baseline records through
scripts/credit_capacity.py. Only trials1-14 at training tempos2/4/6 are included.
Columns are the six active polarity-split incoming eligibility features, with
known_weights from the split event-balanced fit. Each polarity's clipped mean
exceeds0.1 at each training tempo; no quiet cap is imposed in the regression.

The installed solver's presolve incorrectly rejected this known-feasible case.
Direct evaluation of the constructed constraints gives zero violation for the
known vector. With presolve disabled, the solver finds a feasible solution.
No weights from this fixture are installed in the neural model.
